title: Deep Equal
description:
Implement `deepEqual(a, b)` that returns `true` if two values are deeply equal — recursively comparing object properties and array elements.

**Example:**
```js
deepEqual({ a: [1, 2] }, { a: [1, 2] }); // true
deepEqual({ a: 1 }, { a: 2 });           // false
deepEqual(null, null);                   // true
```
ai_context: Common mistakes: using === only (misses nested structures), forgetting null check before typeof (null is typeof 'object'), and not verifying both objects have the same number of keys.
